meta.description: Mock Exam: Career Discovery Week & Industry Mentorship

content.speaker: Student
content.line: Hi, I'm interested in the Career Discovery Week. Can you tell me when it starts?

content.speaker: Coordinator
content.line: Of course! It runs from July 15th to July 19th.

questions.text: Career Discovery Week starts on July _________.

Part_B.situation: You are a member of the Student Union. You are helping to organize the 'Career Discovery Week' where alumni return to share industry insights. You need to complete tasks based on a staff meeting and several documents.

data_file.title: Instruction from Principal
data_file.content:
To: Student Union
From: Principal
Subject: Career Discovery Week

Please ensure we have a good mix of industries, particularly STEM and Creative Arts. We need mentors for the workshop on July 17th.

data_file.title: Alumni Availability Note
data_file.content:
Mr. Wong (Engineer) - Available all week.
Ms. Lee (Designer) - Only available Wed/Fri.

tasks.instructions: Write a short email to Mr. Wong (100 words) inviting him to the July 17th workshop.
Write a proposal (250 words) to the Principal suggesting how to improve industry engagement for next year, using info from the meeting.
